title: Need care, but not sure where to start?
label: The challenge
body: From finding a treatment to booking a visit, follow one simple journey.

title: Explore treatments that fit your needs.
label: Find a service
body: Compare treatments, session lengths and prices in one place.

title: Review the treatment. Take the next step.
label: Review treatment
body: Read about your chosen treatment, then select Book Appointment.

title: Choose a day that works for you.
label: Choose a date
body: Select an available date. Your treatment stays attached to the booking.

title: See availability. Pick your time.
label: Choose a time
body: Choose 10:00. Unavailable time slots are clearly marked.

title: Add your details in one simple form.
label: Your information
body: Enter your contact details and choose your healthcare coverage.

title: Everything looks right? Confirm your visit.
label: Confirm booking
body: Review the treatment, date and time, then confirm your appointment.

title: Your appointment, all in one place.
label: Confirmation
body: Find your appointment details, location and preparation notes together.

title: From finding care to a visit in your calendar.
label: Ready for your visit
body: Add the appointment to your calendar and get ready for your visit.
